title: Best Buy achieves ‘zero waste’ goal at supply chain facilities
summary: The consumer electronics giant said 29 of its supply chain facilities received TRUE Certification from GBCI.

title: WM revisits Pennsylvania plans; Latest on Casella-operated Maine landfill
summary: In other news, the U.S. EPA also proposed to remove one landfill site from its National Priorities List under its Superfund program and partially remove another.

title: Toast among first companies sued under Colorado’s electronics repair law
summary: Acme Revival, which connects customers with electronics repair technicians, also sued Owl Labs and Blackmagic Design, saying the companies refused to provide parts and schematics required by law.

title: US Plastics Pact removes transport EPS from ‘problematic’ list
summary: This is the first time the group has removed an item from the approximately four-year-old list. A broader review of the materials on the list is underway.

title: Widespread errors found in EPA’s E-Manifest hazardous waste system
summary: The agency’s inspector general found that just 0.5% of hazardous waste shipments were recorded in the tracking system electronically, many of which had errors. EPA is mulling a switch forcing an end to paper manifests.

title: Nearly 60 members of Congress call for aluminum pricing investigation
summary: At issue is the Midwest Premium, which reportedly incorporates the 50% aluminum tariffs on domestic manufacturers — even those that use domestically recycled aluminum.

title: Judges reject waste sector challenge to EPA’s PFAS hazardous designation
summary: The decision maintains PFOS and PFOA as hazardous substances under CERCLA. NWRA and others sued the agency in 2024, saying EPA overstepped its authority and created industry liability.

title: California compostables bills, opposed by BPI, won’t advance
summary: “This is a major, but short-term, accomplishment in California,” said BPI Executive Director Rhodes Yepsen. Also this summer, USDA previewed plans to potentially update organics regulations.
